thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: See code.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find all unique combinations that sum up to a target value, accounting for duplicates, we can use a backtracking approach. Starting from each candidate element, we explore all possible combinations by adding the element to the current combination and recursively searching for the remaining sum. To handle duplicates, we skip adding the same element if it has already been processed at the same depth level.
